checks: Extend original plan by one typed mffmpeg row: exact physical and namespace paths, before/after SHA, size, metadata, observed dev/inode and unique backup path. Bind final r3 source/transform/receipt pins; never run rejected 792 as standalone admission.

Fresh held/boot/parent birth/exe and P0 cfg91e31b95 remain unchanged; parent view and physical mffmpeg dev/inode/SHA/meta must agree. Reject symlink/path alias drift. Do not infer metadata from compat/run.
Verify all three current preimages before any destination write; original mffmpeg must be fecf91e1, not arbitrary observed bytes.
Persist original run and mffmpeg backups, verify both full SHA/metadata before the first target replacement; do not overwrite an existing backup.
Stage and verify exact compat and transformed mffmpeg. For nested mffmpeg path use a sibling temporary file inside lib/arm64-v8a, with checked ancestry, nonexistence and unique transaction suffix.

Order: compat then mffmpeg then run last. Immediately before each rename recheck its authorized preimage and captured inode, plus applicable boot/parent guard. Copy only into temporary files; never truncate live targets. Preserve explicit remote rc and per-command raw output.
Read back all three postimages and P0 cfg; status remains FILES_SWAPPED_FRESH_BOOT_REQUIRED. Old running maps are not proof of new code.
Require the original apply-plan and backup identities; verify all applicable backups and unchanged P0 cfg before any restore/removal. Do not create a new original backup on rollback.

For the actual complete apply case admit exact candidate source files; for interruption admit only exact before/after states tied to this transaction intents/observations. Unknown bytes or temporary state must refuse with evidence; do not silently call it absent.

Restore run via original-template/current verified WID derivation and restore exact fecf91e1 mffmpeg atomically with original metadata; remove only exact compat candidate. Reverse apply order for three target changes. Backups/staging evidence retained.

Original inode number cannot be restored by copying: verify restored byte/meta identity and physical/view equality to the new restored inode. After successful source rollback, existing fresh boot/parent restart and baseline checks remain mandatory; source restoration is not runtime restoration.
Use the existing fresh-boot lifecycle, new PID/birth identity and P0 controls; inspect physical/new-parent/new-child views for exact r3 SHA/meta and same dev/inode.

When player loading is attempted, group mffmpeg maps by device+inode and load bias, not map-row count. Require canonical transformed inode, no original fecf inode and no .westlake-init alternative. Multiple segment rows are normal; two distinct load biases for one inode still mean two mappings.

Combine fresh view SHA with loader outcome and consumer dependency evidence. Maps alone do not establish namespace, selected symbols, successful TTPlayer JNI load, Surface presentation or audio. Keep exact provider-aware closure requirement; no machine-wide symbol union.
No candidate promotion from load evidence alone: actual video frames/audio remain separately observed or unknown.
